changelog:
ClawCall 1.0.12

- Added support for configuring global voice, personality, and greeting, as well as inbound profile instructions.
- Expanded description and workflows to include setting up ClawCall profile/personality and voice.
- Added a new reference file: references/profile-and-personality.md.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.
- Clarified difference between general call instructions and persistent profile settings.
- Updated guidance for when and how to gather or use personality/greeting/voice in calls.
